name: drawer
title: Drawer
description: shadcn/ui's base-nova drawer, fixed: the grab handle is the 36x5 bar drawn (shadcn's is 96x4), and the overlay is a flat scrim, without the blur of the page behind it. From the bottom it is clear of the home indicator; DrawerContent's size is default, tall (to 1rem under the status bar) or full; on a short screen its footer's buttons are side by side. Its spacing on the 4px module (docs/grid.md). Its overlay and popup move together by the theme's motion-slide (400ms on --ease-slide; a release a share of it by the swipe's strength), one curve where they had two.
